environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. The ALB target group forwards traffic on port 8080 to the Fargate task. The ALB security group allows inbound on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF is attached. The service is used by partner integrations and is documented in the external API portal. The LDAP server is an internal OpenLDAP instance reachable from the Fargate task's VPC.
